title: Insha ya Maelezo (Theme 7: Matunda na mimea)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya maelezo before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti".

misconceptions.repair: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.

misconceptions.ask: Msomaji anaona nini akisoma sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.

listen_for: mwagilia maji, funika kwa udongo, weka mche, chimba shimo
misconceptions.ask: Unaweza kufanya hatua hii kabla ya ile?
misconceptions.repair: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.

listen_for: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii inahusiana vipi na anwani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?
checks.answer: Kwanza, chimba shimo lenye kina cha futi mbili.

checks.question: Insha ya maelezo ina sehemu zipi?
